summary: The fingerprinted module closure is the loaded modules the repository tracks; a gitignored module gets no row

tests: a gitignored module the program loaded gets no provenance row

pins: emit writes a provenance row for each local module the program loaded
a module under node modules gets no provenance row
notes: Per 0083: judged by real path against the ignore rules discovery already honours — reuse its ignore machinery, never hand-roll gitignore matching. A tracked workspace package (GH #61) keeps its row. Dogfood lock re-emit is a human half.
